facts.fact: IGAD, with EU funding, handed digital health equipment to Djibouti's Ministry of Health on 2 December 2024, as one of the IGAD Member States across which the equipment is distributed.

systems.system: EU Digital Solutions project (IGAD health surveillance)
systems.owner: IGAD with GIZ and the EU
systems.tiers: Ministry of Health HMIS/Digital Health/IDSR sections, district health offices, three cross-border facilities
